summary: Implemented Console.out in rich/console.py, placed after print. It joins str() of each object with sep, then calls self.print once with emoji=False, markup=False, no_wrap=True, overflow="ignore", crop=False, passing end, style, and highlight (default True) through. Added a CHANGELOG bullet "Added Console.out" under 9.0.0 Added, a "Low level output" section after the logging section in docs/source/console.rst, and test_out_* tests before test_show_cursor in tests/test_console.py. Tests were not run, per instructions, so they are unverified. No commits made.
